content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen works well—photo, season eyebrow, headline and one link in a clean dark panel—but the giant two-line footer wordmark feels out of scale against the rest of the page.","desktopNote":"The overlapping hero panel hides the lower half of the tent and pushes the headline and link to the very bottom of the fold, while the contact cards and feature sections sit in a lot of loose vertical space.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop hero: shift the text panel right or shorten the photo so the headline, intro and 'Poglejte cene' sit fully within the first screen and the orange tent is not covered.","Desktop: tighten the 'Obiščite nas' cards (less empty height) and reduce padding around the camper/kitchen sections and the half-empty 'Dodatno' price column.","Footer: scale the 'Kamp Soška' wordmark down on phone (it dominates two full lines) and trim the repeated phone/address block since it already appears in 'Obiščite nas'."],"blockers":[]}
